info.title: ICANN RDAP Official Domain WHOIS, Brand & Antifraud Auditor
info.description:
Audits corporate and e-commerce domains via official ICANN & Verisign RDAP JSON registries (Zero-Key, replaces paid WHOIS APIs). Extracts registration/expiration dates, registrar, DNSSEC, lock status, and Domain Trust Scores (0-100).

### Enterprise B2B Value Proposition (ICANN RDAP Official Domain WHOIS, Brand & Antifraud Auditor)
- **Target B2B Buyers:** Brand Protection Agencies, SOC Threat Hunters, Fraud Prevention Engines, and Domain Registrars.
- **Zero External API Keys Required:** Connects directly to authoritative government, regulatory, and financial primary registries with built-in retry/backoff and deterministic schema normalization.
- **Quantitative Scoring & RAG Briefs:** Every record is enriched with a quantitative 0-100 risk/viability score and an LLM-ready Markdown executive brief (`ICANN RDAP Official Domain WHOIS Audited`).
- **Marketplace Categories:** RapidAPI `Cybersecurity` | Zyla API Hub `Security`.
- **Subscription Tiers (USD):** `BASIC` ($0.00/mo, 15 req/mo hard cap), `PRO` ($19.00/mo, 1,000 req/mo + $0.02/extra), `ULTRA` ($49.00/mo, 5,000 req/mo + $0.015/extra), `MEGA` ($149.00/mo, 25,000 req/mo + $0.010/extra).
- **SEO Keywords:** icann-rdap, whois-lookup, domain-age, brand-protection, dnssec-audit, anti-phishing, threat-intelligence.

import httpx

url = "https://b2b-quant-rapidapi-gateway.jesleytassili.workers.dev/v1/icann-rdap-domain-whois-brand-recon"
payload = {
    "domains": "stripe.com,cloudflare.com,shopify.com",
    "maxResults": 5
}
headers = {
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
    "X-RapidAPI-Host": "icann-rdap-domain-whois-brand-recon.p.rapidapi.com",
    "X-RapidAPI-Key": "<YOUR_RAPIDAPI_OR_ZYLA_KEY>",
}

with httpx.Client(timeout=30.0) as client:
    response = client.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.json())
